proposal.observation: ZN-E005 (ResConv-MaskedSummary-H0) KEEP on split 2021: MAPE 0.3216, Acc@15 0.4055, RMSE 445.0, gradient HEALTHY.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: The ZN-E005 configuration generalises to paper split 42: finite, healthy-gradient run whose metrics enter the 3-split mean ± std compared with the paper Zn-ion table (CPMLP 0.558±0.034 / 0.297±0.084; CPTransformer 0.515±0.067).
proposal.question_inherited: Is the ZN-E005 split-2021 gain reproducible on the other paper splits?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Split dependence of the ResConv-MaskedSummary-H0 result.
proposal.why_this_experiment: state.json split_protocol: KEEP candidates are confirmed on splits 42 and 2024 with identical config/seed before further comparison (Codex ZN-E005 analysis).
proposal.modification: None vs ZN-E005: identical model and training; only BL_SPLIT=42.
proposal.held_constant_components: Model (ResConv-MaskedSummary-H0, 85,697 params) and all training settings fixed from ZN-E005: Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, A2-ZN epoch rule, checkpoint rule, preprocessing.
proposal.controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps. Sole changed variable: split 42 (BL_SPLIT=42).
proposal.expected_evidence: Split-42 selected-checkpoint MAPE, Acc@15, RMSE, DB-MAPE (tools/rescore.py), EOL bands, pred SD/corr, gradient gate; contributes to the prespecified 3-split mean ± std with ZN-E005 (split 2021) and the other confirmation run.
proposal.rejection_condition: Per-run disposition: VALID with gradient gate PASS -> KEEP (as confirmation evidence); VALID with gradient gate FAIL -> DISCARD; protocol/finite/completeness failure -> INVALID, no decision. Candidate-level aggregate (decided after ZN-E007 over ZN-E005/E006/E007 = splits 2021/42/2024, same config and seed): CONFIRMED iff 3-split mean MAPE < 0.515 (beats paper Zn-ion best, CPTransformer) AND 3-split mean Acc@15 > 0.297 (beats paper CPMLP) AND all three runs KEEP; otherwise NOT CONFIRMED (stays a split-2021 result; no further ResConv tuning — the next step is the new phase-split curve-encoder family).
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; ResConv stem/residual-block, inter_summary and head (inter_mlp) gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.
